features.name: zero_balance
features.description: 1 if the account balance is exactly 0.

features.name: balance_to_salary
features.description: Balance / EstimatedSalary: how much of their income the customer keeps in the bank.

features.name: products_per_tenure
features.description: NumOfProducts / (Tenure + 1): product uptake per year of relationship; +1 keeps tenure 0 finite.

features.name: is_senior
features.description: 1 if Age >= 50 (the highest-churn age band in EDA).

features.name: active_x_products
features.description: IsActiveMember * NumOfProducts: product depth, counted only for active members.

split.method: exact stratified on Exited, ordered by seeded hash of CustomerId

notes: Identifiers dropped. No scaling applied; fit scalers on the train split only.
